purpose: Minimal, hash-bound repairs for confirmed silent gaps in otherwise reusable IELTS audio.

segments.text: For those who use several clubs, Gold membership is the best choice. Gold members receive free entry to all LP Clubs.
For the written report, add more graphs. At the moment it is too text-heavy, and visuals would make the results easier to follow.
For future work, make your sample larger. You should also check the reliability of your sources.
